messages:
Daria: idea: add a small capability_lease + evidence_envelope pair to the manifest flow so runtime and SDKs can reason about stale capability info and give compact, auditable fallback proofs. sketch below.

Jason: +1. we need a cheap canonical way to tie a fallback decision back to the adapter state without shipping full traces.

Mei: for private installs this must be opt-in. customers can't be forced to export anything. can the envelope be stored locally and retrievable via admin API?

Daria: yes. default behavior: envelope_policy=summary; if adapter can't push out, it still writes a local ledger. The envelope is short (base64) and includes: manifest_epoch, decision, reason_code, ticket, cost_delta_ms, sig. HMAC key scoped per-tenant or per-region.

Omar: runtime rule: when controlplane hasn't seen a manifest update within capability_lease seconds, assume conservative defaults (deny kv_share/rollout_swap). capability_lease must be part of manifest metadata so adapters express how long their capability assertions are valid.

Daria: sketch envelope example (compact):
```
base64( {"v":"1","epoch":"2026-03-22T18:00:00Z","decision":"local->dedicated","reason":"KV_MISS","cost_ms":"14","ticket":"A1bC9x","sig":"hmac:..."} )
```
(we'll actually HMAC and base64 the bytes; shown here unencoded for readability)

Jason: SDK behavior: surface a typed FallbackEnvelope object on fallback errors but default to redacted view. apps opt into full envelope decoding for support. Also provide a short header X-RW-Fallback-Info with the ticket id and reason so logs can correlate without parsing long blobs.

Mei: UI expectations: show "fallback ledger" entry with time, chosen_target, reason, ticket. If envelope unverified or unavailable (private/no egress) show a "telemetry degraded" badge and link to local-admin instructions.

Omar: safety: add op_grace_window in seconds so rolling upgrades don't break in-flight ops. if manifest_epoch changes but op started before epoch+grace_window, allow completion. We'll need to record request start time in adapter logs to enforce this.

Daria: also propose capability_ttl (seconds) in manifest. adapter says capability_ttl:600 meaning controlplane can trust the manifest for 10m. After that controlplane must probe or default-deny. Avoids storms during mass rollout.

Jason: error mapping: denied fallback -> HTTP 409 + body {code:"ERR_FALLBACK_DENIED", ticket:"A1bC9x", reason:"KV_MISS"} + header X-RW-Fallback-Ticket: A1bC9x. SDK maps to FallbackDenied exception with small payload (reason, ticket).

Mei: privacy: envelopes must not include PII or raw prompt text unless tenant explicitly enables it. default redact fields. document this clearly.

Omar: ops: store last N decoded envelopes per region (configurable) to reconstruct cascades. retention default 7d. if envelope sig can't be verified (missing key), show amber "unverified" marker; don't discard the event.

Daria: testability: add dry_switch/dry_envelope flag so controlplane can simulate the switch and generate a faux envelope without routing traffic. Useful for perf/cost canaries. opt-in per-tenant.

Jason: TL;DR: add capability_ttl + op_grace_window to manifest, introduce compact evidence_envelope for fallback events (ticket+reason+sig), keep telemetry optional and local-first, surface tiny headers for correlation, SDK typed errors. I'll help draft RFC text.
